culture-cycles.note: Bank holidays notified for the RBI Vijayawada office for 2026; state government offices usually close on these days too, but the state's own gazette list can differ. Where RBI shows several festival names for one day, the label lists all of them; the one that applies here is the festival observed in this state. Dates before 5 November 2026 have passed; replace with the 2027 list when RBI publishes it. Lunar and Islamic dates move each year. 5 November 2026 applies to NTR district only.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: At Tirumala: bathe and wear clean clothes before entering the shrine, keep silence inside the temple, wait your turn in the darshan queue and put offerings only in the Hundi. Don't eat non-vegetarian food, drink alcohol, take other intoxicants or smoke anywhere in Tirumala. Don't carry much jewellery or cash.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: No footwear in or around the temple premises; no helmets, caps, turbans or hats inside; don't wear flowers (all flowers of the Seven Hills are for the deity); don't prostrate inside the temple; don't enter if custom bars you. Weapons must be declared at the Alipiri check point or legal action follows.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD), the temple trust.
culture-and-protocol.note: Tirumala and Tirupati only, from TTD's own list. Not a statewide rule.
